Form-field replaces the injected Angular animation-mode token with the owned legacy token; the same constructor condition still computes the animation flag, so label animation policy can differ with providers. Trigger uses form-field host containment, floatLabel and label-lock methods, control value assignment, label ID, connected origin and color. Their complete targeted members are recorded; only the constructor injection changes. Actual label motion, DI and overlay interaction require current-subject runtime evidence.

The core barrel adds exactly two animation exports; the existing _LegacyViewport export remains byte-identical and resolves to the same owned module. The viewport implementation itself matches the prior evidence hash; the trigger continues to alias the owned token, not CDK ViewportRuler. The added animation exports do not prove injector or viewport behavior.
limitations: Static dependency and source-identity requalification only; historical executions retain original subjects, and the changed animation/label/overlay interaction is not re-executed here. No G11 or release claim.
